title: USS Liberty: Message Ordering USS Amberjack on "Special Operations" on 8JUN67

communications.subject: Freedom of Information Act Request: USS Liberty: Message Ordering USS Amberjack on "Special Operations" on 8JUN67
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

I am a survivor of the June 8, 1967, Israeli attack on the USS Liberty and serve my shipmates as Vice President and Historian of the USS Liberty Veterans Association https://ussliberty.org

In the Deck Log of the USS Amberjack (SS522) is the ship’s log entry for June 1-9, 1967. (Attached)

The first entry under “Remarks” is “1-8 June Special Operations.”

We are requesting a copy of the message detailing the specifics of the “Special Operations” the USS Amberjack was ordered to carry out.

Joe Meadors
joe@ussliberty.com

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Joe Meadors
